_comment: Scaffold for the a11y-perf gate (.github/workflows/a11y-perf.yml). Fill in real routes and budgets, pin AXE_VERSION/LHCI_VERSION in the workflow, then delete the "a11y-perf-scaffold": true line to arm the gate. See tools/ci/README.md > Arming checklist.

budgets.note: Lighthouse budgets live in the project's lighthouserc.js/json (URLs, local server command, assertions). This file only lists the routes axe-core scans; the scaffold marker above keeps the gate skipping until both are real.
